dialect.detail: IBM CICS/DB2 application, part of IBM's LGXX sample insurance application (CB12 product code, copyright IBM Corp. 2011-2013). Uses EXEC CICS and EXEC SQL with DB2 host variables, SQLCA, DFHCOMMAREA, EIB fields.

purpose.domain_detail: IBM LGTESTAPP insurance sample application - adds a new customer record to a DB2 CUSTOMER table, obtaining a customer number via CICS named counter (GENA pool) or DB2 IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL()
purpose.summary: LGACDB01 is a CICS online subprogram that adds a new customer entry to a DB2 CUSTOMER table. It obtains a customer number from a CICS named counter pool, inserts the customer's name, address, date of birth and contact details, then links to LGACVS01 (VSAM) and LGACDB02 (security) programs. Error handling writes diagnostic messages to a TDQ via LGSTSQ.

notable_features: EXEC SQL DB2 INSERT with host variables
EXEC CICS LINK to multiple programs (LGACDB02, LGACVS01, LGSTSQ)
EXEC CICS Get Counter (named counter service for customer number generation)
DB2 IDENTITY_VAL_LOCAL() fallback when named counter unavailable
SQLCA included via EXEC SQL INCLUDE
DFHCOMMAREA defined via EXEC SQL INCLUDE LGCMAREA
EXEC CICS ASKTIME/FORMATTIME for error logging
Hardcoded password string in working storage (security concern)
verdict.notes: This is part of the well-known IBM LGTESTAPP (Life and General insurance) sample CICS application shipped with IBM CICS TS. The comment 'RLAM 06/04/2021 10:11 Test Code Coverage' suggests it was modified for code coverage testing. The hardcoded password '5732fec825535eeafb8fac50fee3a8aa' in working storage is notable. Max line length of 72 confirms strict fixed-format COBOL.
